messages.text:
Buenas tardes, Luis:

Me llamo Valentina Robles y estudio séptimo semestre de diseño gráfico en Zapopan. Encontré su nombre de una forma un poco rara: el sábado fui a la cafetería de Tueste Laja y Niebla en Chapultepec y me quedé viendo las bolsas nuevas de 250 g como diez minutos. Le pregunté a la chica de la barra quién las había diseñado y me dijo su nombre y que vive en Londres. Busqué su portafolio y de ahí saqué este correo. Perdón si es atrevido escribirle así.

Le escribo porque acabo de conseguir mi primer trabajo de empaque de verdad, fuera de la escuela: una miel de Mazamitla, frascos de 350 g y de 1 kg, etiqueta y una caja para regalo. Es de los papás de una compañera, son muy buena onda, pero yo no tengo idea de cómo hacer varias cosas y en la escuela nadie habla de dinero. Tengo tres preguntas, si tiene tiempo:

1. ¿Cómo cobra un empaque así alguien que va empezando? Ellos me preguntaron "cuánto sería" y yo les dije que les mandaba algo esta semana. Pensaba cobrar por hora pero no sé cuántas horas me voy a tardar.

2. ¿Se cobra aparte la visita a la imprenta para revisar color? Mi profesor dice que siempre hay que ir, pero la imprenta está en Guadalajara y el cliente en Mazamitla, y no sé quién paga eso.

3. Esta es más personal. Usted estudió la maestría en Londres, según su página. ¿Le sirvió para trabajar allá o fue más el estar ahí? Estoy pensando en aplicar a algo afuera en 2026 y mis papás me preguntan si vale la pena endeudarse.

Sé que es mucho. Aunque me conteste solo una, se lo agradecería muchísimo. Y si algún día da una plática en Guadalajara, ahí estaré.

Muchas gracias por su tiempo,
Valentina Robles

truth.summary: Valentina Robles, a design student in Zapopan who saw his Tueste Laja y Niebla bags, asks Luis three questions about pricing her first packaging job, who pays for a press check, and whether his London MA was worth it; he hasn't replied.

subject: Strength studio closing for the refurb: your class pass

messages.text:
Hi Luis,

The strength studio at the back is closing for its refurbishment from Monday 18 August to Friday 12 September. We're replacing the floor and finally getting the heating sorted. You're on the Strong Shins pass you took when I discharged you in May, £38 a month, which renews on the 15th. That gives you three choices:

1. Freeze it. Nothing is taken on 15 August and it starts again from 15 September.
2. Keep paying and come to the Tuesday 7pm class we're running at the church hall on Sandringham Road while the studio's shut. Same class, worse floor.
3. Cancel. It's a month's notice, so you'd pay this month and that's it.

I need to know which by Wednesday 13 August, so reception can make any changes before the cards are charged on Friday. If I don't hear, the pass carries on as it is and you can come to the church hall.

While you're on a break, please keep doing the calf work at home. Three times a week is plenty:

Single-leg calf raises, slow on the way down
3 sets of 15 each side
Stop if the pain along the inside of the shin goes above 3 out of 10

Tibialis raises against the wall
3 sets of 20
Stop if you feel it at the front of the shin the next morning

While I've got you, are you still under 40 km a week? If the shin hurts on a run, tell me when it starts and how long it takes to settle.

Harriet

Harriet Lowe MCSP
Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

subject: Class of 2018, ten years too early

messages.text:
Dear Luis,

It is Sunday, Lotte is building a tower out of the type specimens I left on the floor, and I have decided this is a sign that I should do some admin before she gets to the drawers.

The admin is this. The college has written to say there will be an alumni evening for our MA year and the one after, on Friday 3 July, in the old studio building, the one with the radiators that only worked on Thursdays. They are calling it a reunion, which seems early to me, as reunions are for people who have changed, and I have only got a daughter and a bad back.

But I would like to go, and I would like it more if you went. Registration closes on 15 May. It is free, there is wine, and there will be a talk by someone from our year who now runs a studio in Copenhagen and whom neither of us liked very much.

If I come, I would stay the weekend. Might the sofa be free from Thursday 2 July to Sunday 5? I promise to leave no proofs drying on the kitchen table this time, or only small ones.

Love, Felix

the sofa question first: almost certainly, but there's a chance we're not in this flat by then. the rent's going up and we're looking. I'll let you know when we know about the flat.

and yes I'll go, if only to sit at the back during the Copenhagen talk with you. will register this week.

L

Rita, Clara, meet Felix properly (you've heard me talk about him, he's the type designer in Berlin). He's coming over for our MA thing on Friday 3 July and staying the weekend.

any chance either of you is in London that weekend? I'd love to do a long lunch on the Saturday, the four of us. Felix, these two are the best of the Bermondsey lot, I've told you about them.

L

Hi Luis!

What a nice idea. I can travel that weekend, but the theatre is in its last week of the season, so I can't leave work early on the Friday. I could be on a train on Saturday at 7 and in London for lunch, then back Sunday evening.

Felix, hello! Luis has talked about your typeface so much I feel I've used it.

Alright all

Results from Saturday's summer handicap are attached. 47 finishers, which is a record for July, and nobody went in the canal, which is also a record. Fastest time on the day was Kofi in 31:40, and the handicap win goes to Maggie, who started first and was never caught. Times are gun times; if yours looks wrong by more than a few seconds, tell me before Friday and I'll fix it before it goes on the website.

Thanks to the marshals, especially Harriet at the turn by the boathouse, who stood in one place for an hour and a half in the sun. Cake money came to £38, which goes towards the new finish clock.

We've pencilled in 17 October for the autumn handicap. I'll be doing the results again because nobody else volunteered at the AGM, and I'm told it's character building.

Callum

Hi lovely people, I've got a DQ next to my name and I ran the whole thing, I promise. Did I miss the cone at the boathouse? If I did, fair enough, but nobody said anything at the finish and I'd like to know before I tell everyone at work I came third.

Ife

Hi Ife,

You went round the cone, I watched you. You were with the two in the green vests and you all went the right way.

The only person I sent back on Saturday was a man in a red cap who tried to turn at the bench instead. I took his number, 112, and gave it to Callum at the finish. I think the DQ might belong to him and has ended up on the wrong line.

For what it's worth, Ife, you looked comfortable all the way round, which is more than I can say for most of the field after the second lap. Everyone who ran in that heat: please drink properly today as well, not just on the day. Lots of people were grey at the finish.

Harriet

Harriet Lowe MCSP
Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

Alright Ife

Harriet's right. I sorted the sheet by surname after typing the DQ in and it slid down a row onto you. Number 112 was the DQ. You were third woman, 52:14 on the clock. Corrected version attached, the website will have the right one by tonight.

Apologies. Next year I'm doing the results on paper with a pencil like a proper club.

Callum

Third woman! Thanks both. Harriet, I owe you a drink for watching my feet.

Ife

Dear Luis, dear Mateo,

I do still have it.  It lives in the bureau drawer beside my father's binoculars and a box of slides of the Cairngorms I have not looked at since 1991, and I am pleased that one of the three will be useful at last.

It is a heavy thing, and the light meter has been unreliable since about the time of the miners' strike, so Mateo will need either a separate meter or a telephone that pretends to be one.  The shutter is fine.  I took it to Skye in 1987 and it survived the rain better than I did.

Which building, Mateo?  I ask because if it is anywhere near the Dean Village, I lived in a flat above a bookbinder's there for two years, and I should like to know whether the bookbinder is still there.

Saturday the 3rd at eleven would suit me well.  9 Aberdour Road, the blue door.  The doorbell is unreliable; knock firmly.  You may keep it until the end of November, as I shall be in Edinburgh myself for my daughter's wedding on 28 November and can collect it from you there, which saves everyone a parcel.

Yours, Hamish Fairweather

messages.text:
Qué tal, banda:

Un cliente nuevo (una S.A. de C.V.) me depositó $150 MXN menos de lo que dice la factura. El subtotal era de $12,000 MXN y su contadora me dice que descontó el 1.25% de ISR. Estoy en RESICO desde enero, pero hasta ahorita todos mis clientes habían sido personas físicas.

¿Es normal? ¿Lo tengo que poner yo en la factura o lo ponen ellos? Ya la timbré sin la retención y no sé si la tengo que cancelar.

Tadeo

Tadeo Benavides · ilustración y empaque · Puebla

Buen día,

Los $150 corresponden al 1.25% sobre el subtotal, antes de IVA. Pídale a la contadora que le confirme cómo quiere que sustituya el CFDI para que aparezca la retención.

Atte. C.P. Emilio Cárdenas

C.P. Emilio Cárdenas Ruelas
Administración y Finanzas | Tueste Laja y Niebla S.A. de C.V.
administracion@lajayniebla.example

¡Hola, Tadeo!

Acá en Laja y Niebla Emilio me acaba de regresar la factura de unas fotos para las bolsas por lo mismo. Mándale el XML nuevo directo a la contadora. Yo reenvié el puro PDF y ahí se nos fueron otros dos días.

Gracias, Mariana

Gracias, Emilio y Mariana. Ya cancelé la factura y la contadora del cliente aceptó la cancelación ayer.

Me quedó una duda: ¿esos $150 se toman en cuenta en la declaración del mes? Mi contador regresa hasta el 12.

Tadeo

Tadeo Benavides · ilustración y empaque · Puebla

Hola Tadeo

En el hotel yo solo mando los XML corregidos a administración. Te diría que le pases el nuevo a tu contador cuando vuelva. De la declaración no te sabría decir.

Rena
